# Semmelstulle / atkins.sh

## About
Personal homepage and project portfolio of Dennis Tobias Atkins, a software developer based in Germany. The site showcases creations, including personal iOS apps, Minecraft resources, Widgy widgets, and the website itself.

- Domain: https://semmelstulle.github.io
- Also served via: https://atkins.sh
- GitHub: https://github.com/Semmelstulle / https://github.com/SemmelStulle
- Mastodon: https://mastodon.social/@Semmelstulle

## Projects

### StarterSeeds
An iOS game launcher that lets you start your favorite iOS games from one place, pin favorites, and browse your full library. Includes a photo gallery view usable with a game controller.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/starterseeds/id6757363455
- AltStore PAL source: https://atkins.sh/altstore/apps.json
- Latest version: 1.3 (2026-04-08)
- Bundle ID: com.semmelstulle.StarterSeeds
- Privacy: No personal data is collected.

### Peawell
An iOS journaling and medication-tracking app. It was built for App Store submission but was not published due to prolonged App Review communication issues. Source and screenshots are available on GitHub.
- Repository: https://github.com/Semmelstulle/Peawell-iOS

### SemmelTweaks
A Minecraft resource pack (.mcpack) with quality-of-life texture tweaks, including custom sun/moon, no pumpkin overlay, clear glass, effect-labeled potions/arrows, and more.
- Download: https://semmelstulle.github.io/resources/files/SemmelTweaks.mcpack

### Widgy Widgets
A collection of iOS home-screen widgets for the Widgy app, including weather widgets, Xbox profile cards, calendar widgets, Reddit feeds, and dynamic widgets in English and German.
- Download: https://semmelstulle.github.io/resources/files/

### This Website
A hand-built, single-page personal site designed to work on legacy devices (including EdgeHTML / Windows Phone) while still looking modern. It uses embedded CSS and JavaScript, supports dark/light mode, and all graphics are original.
- Source: https://github.com/Semmelstulle/semmelstulle.github.io
- License: MIT

## Privacy
StarterSeeds and this website do not collect, store, transmit, or process any personal information. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages; GitHub may collect technical data such as IP addresses in server logs. See GitHub’s privacy statement for details.
